definitions.explanation: The ability to endure difficulty or hardship without complaining.

examples.japanese: {忍耐|にんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{忍耐|にんたい}⟦{強|づよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忍耐|にんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}→感心：02559_kanshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{忍耐|にんたい} emphasizes enduring hardship with mental strength.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {忍耐|にんたい}⟦{強|づよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: patient, persevering
- {忍耐|にんたい}⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧: perseverance, ability to endure
- {忍耐|にんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧: limit of one's patience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧: patience, self-control (more about suppressing desires)
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}→辛抱：05101_shinbou⟧: patience, endurance (slightly more casual)
- ⟦{根気|こんき}→根気：02734_konki⟧: perseverance (focus on continuing effort)
